notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 243 pieces, 58 lines.

The remaining separate groups are real. The booklet builds them as loose items that are never fastened to the cave. (1) The main model: Cave, grass block and chest platform. They are connected by b219/b220 bridging b16 and b152, and by the chest platform b221/b223/b224 clutching jumpers b127/b129/b128. (2) The spider (b130-b151) is a separate model that is only set on the ground beside the cave on page 35 and is not attached to it. (3) The bucket with handle and blue round plate (b240-b242) is a loose accessory on the ground. (4) The loose orange round plate b243 lies on the ground next to the bucket and clutches nothing. (5) Steve's pickaxe b1 is held in the minifigure's hand. The minifigure body parts are not in the parts list, so nothing recorded can be joined to it.

The layer-3 1x1 plates and rounds in the 'units' each rest on exactly one piece of the layer below. Each unit is a 2x2 plate, then two round 1x1 on one diagonal and two 1x1 plates on the other, then the types swapped on top, then a jumper on all four.
Minifigure heads, torsos and legs (Steve, Zombie) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded.

Plates built upside down and then flipped are recorded in their final orientation. The 8x8 plates b2 and b152 rest on the bricks hung underneath them, and the 6x6 plate b16 rests on its four corner bricks.

The booklet pictures are small. The exact brick lengths (2x4, 2x6, 2x8, 2x10) and some rests_on entries were inferred from the pictures, the step boxes and the parts-list counts. This applies especially where sub-assemblies join the main model: b2 on b17, the orange ramp b99/b105, and the blue-water bridge b96.
Bread b233 sits loose inside the chest bottom b231. Tiles beneath the chest platform only touch it. Pages 36-39 (rebuild ideas) reuse existing pieces and add none.
